name: Valentine's Day
hook: February 14 is a Jeopardy peg for massacres, statehood, births and candy hearts.

facts.label: the St. Valentine's Day Massacre
facts.statement: The 1929 St. Valentine's Day Massacre was Al Capone's men, disguised as policemen, killing seven of Bugs Moran's gang in Chicago.

facts.label: Captain James Cook
facts.statement: Captain James Cook was killed in Hawaii on Valentine's Day 1779 during a dispute over a stolen boat.

facts.label: Jimmy Hoffa
facts.statement: Jimmy Hoffa, the Teamsters president, was born on Valentine's Day 1913 in Brazil, Indiana.

facts.label: Arizona and Oregon
facts.statement: Arizona became a state on Valentine's Day 1912; Oregon entered the Union on Valentine's Day 1859.

facts.label: Chaucer
facts.statement: Chaucer wrote that birds choose their mates on Valentine's Day in his poem The Parliament of Fowls.

facts.label: My Funny Valentine
facts.statement: 'My Funny Valentine' is the Rodgers and Hart standard whose last line is 'Each day is Valentine's Day.'

facts.label: Sweethearts
facts.statement: Sweethearts, the little candies printed with sayings, claim to be the bestselling Valentine's Day candy.
